description:
Miae, who suffers from “hypersexuality,” has sex with anyone whenever her desires become overwhelming. While getting involved with various men, such as a part-time bookstore employee, a gym coach, and a taxi driver, she begins to feel something she has never experienced before with Jinseop, whom she met at a company dinner. Miae’s body wants to have sex with him, but she is afraid he will discover her true self. She also does not have the courage to break her own rule: never sleep with people around her, especially coworkers. Because of that, Miae deliberately keeps her distance from Jinseop and returns to her promiscuous lifestyle. But in the end, Jinseop catches her in that side of herself.

**Original Webtoon:**    
[Lezhin](https://www.lezhin.com/ko/comic/pretty_girl), [Bomtoon](https://www.bomtoon.com/detail/pretty_girl)
